spec.studio_prompt: A minimalist mushroom table lamp measuring 28 cm in height and 20 cm in diameter. The upper shade is an oblate dome of translucent, warm-glowing opal glass in off-white (#f3e2c9). It rests flush upon a thick, smooth cylindrical base crafted from semi-gloss cream ceramic (#b5a791) with subtle warm undertones (#8f704a). Soft internal ambient illumination evenly diffuses through the glass volume, casting a gentle warm glow downwards onto the pristine lacquer cylinder.
